scope: Read-only native physical-window point, Xorg shape/stack hit path and XRes receiver ownership, bounded metadata and retained focus/substructure observation; no mouse dispatch or AT-SPI coordinate inference

initial_results.finding: Redundant cast after exact int type guard removed; also bound the point reader to the already-selected native window and added actual binding, geometry and depth regressions. No type-ignore or relaxed runtime guard.

physical_point_contract.coordinates: Physical pixels relative to the currently selected X11 window; no AT-SPI conversion or user global point input

native_hit_contract: TranslateCoordinates from selected window to root then root to every actual mapped hit child. QueryTree validates direct parents, roots, exact bounded children/stack order; native geometry and roundtrip coordinates must agree. Xorg chooses shape-aware first-child hit; no client-side rectangular winner inference.
receiver_contract: WM ancestors may be another process. Path must include original selected native window; every node from it to the leaf is matched by actual XRes PID, process creation identity, executable and UID. Viewable same-process InputOnly descendants are accepted; foreign descendants and same-PID unrelated top-level windows rejected.
observation_contract: Existing continuous window/focus/physical-release proof brackets each read. Preparation double-reads hit/geometry/client fingerprint around per-connection StructureNotify/SubstructureNotify; root/path parent subscriptions latch new or reordered siblings. Original FocusChange retained, masks excluded from identity. Cancellation/failure cannot revive the old point. External native window connection/session remain owned externally.

protocol_sources.scope: Same-screen coordinates and mapped child response
ProcTranslateCoords traverses actual child order and tests bounding/input shapes; reviewed upstream source during development, not native runtime validation

native_configuration: All Xorg/logind/AT-SPI connections and replies injected; actual binary reader and complete existing WindowBinding exercised. Default offline guard unchanged. Frozen runtime import and hashes checked before/after. Approved Windows asyncio execution, no user services stopped or environment rebuilt.
next: Complete native pointer mapping/source state, move/press/release packet ownership, semantic-control physical-point binding, per-action business permit and concrete application readback; generic provider association, Tab/Escape/focus outcomes and Wayland input remain open. Full suite follows whole V2 development freeze.
